title: 河川再蜿蜒工程
summary: 再蜿蜒不只是把直線河道畫成曲線，而是重新安排河道長度、洪氾空間、地下水交換與泥砂的移動途徑。十個單元由地形量測走向流況及監測設計，並要求比較工程前後及參照區，避免把自然年際變化誤認為復育工程的單一成果。
summaryEn: Remeandering reorganizes channel length, floodplain space, groundwater exchange and sediment pathways. Ten units move from geometric measurement to flow processes and monitoring design. Comparisons across time and reference reaches help separate restoration signals from natural variation. Learners examine both the intended ecological gains and the hydraulic consequences of reconnecting a river with surrounding land.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課先用「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」建立原創假想基準，再以「展長後的平均坡度」檢查另一個控制機制。第一組輸入及結果為 Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless；第二組為 dz=3 m; L=1800 m; S=dz/L=0.001666667 dimensionless。學員需在同一張工作表分列量綱、時間、位置與適用範圍，先核對守恆，再解釋為何兩個得數不能互相代替。最後以第三單元提出的量測設計驗證假設，並將超出模型能力的水理、生態或治理問題列為待研究項目；這些示例並非所列案例的現場實測。敏感度重算：固定谷地參考長 Lv=1200 m，將中心線 Lc 從 1800 m 增至 1980 m，蜿蜒度由 1.5 增至 1.65。河長與指標同增一成，但這個比值不能單獨證明棲地、洪峰或泥砂平衡改善。
workedExample.textEn: Begin with an original hypothetical baseline for Sinuosity and measurement scale and examine another controlling mechanism through Mean slope after lengthening. The first inputs and result are Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless; the second are dz=3 m; L=1800 m; S=dz/L=0.001666667 dimensionless. Keep dimensions, time, location and validity conditions in separate columns of the same working sheet. Check conservation before explaining why the two numerical results cannot substitute for one another. Use the third unit measurement design to test assumptions and identify hydraulic, ecological or governance questions that exceed the model. These examples are not field observations from the named reference cases. Sensitivity recalculation: Keep valley reference length Lv=1200 m fixed and increase centreline Lc from 1800 m to 1980 m. Sinuosity rises from 1.5 to 1.65. Length and index both increase ten percent, but the ratio alone does not establish improvement in habitat, flood peaks or sediment balance.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」與「展長後的平均坡度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sinuosity and measurement scale" and "Mean slope after lengthening": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 蜿蜒度與量測尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sinuosity and measurement scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」如何影響河川再蜿蜒工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sinuosity and measurement scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River remeandering works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 蜿蜒度比較沿河道中心線與谷地參考路徑的長度，能描述平面幾何，卻不直接代表棲地品質或洪水安全。中心線取自低水槽、滿岸線或影像水面時可能得到不同結果，谷地長度也必須固定相同起訖點。影像解析度太細會把小幅岸線起伏計入長度，太粗則削去彎道。因此工程前後比較應維持相同定義與解析度，先確認幾何變化是真實河道重組而非測圖方式改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sinuosity compares channel-centreline length with a valley reference route, describing plan geometry rather than habitat quality or flood safety. A centreline based on low flow, bankfull edges or visible water can differ, and valley length must use matching endpoints. Fine imagery may count minor irregularities while coarse mapping removes bends. Keep definitions and resolution consistent before and after works so an apparent change represents channel reorganization rather than a different surveying method or mapping scale. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sinuosity and measurement scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「蜿蜒度較大必然代表所有生態功能與防洪能力較好」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Greater sinuosity necessarily means better ecological function and flood protection in every respect" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sinuosity and measurement scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Sinuosity compares channel-centreline length with a valley reference route, describing plan geometry rather than habitat quality or flood safety. A centreline based on low flow, bankfull edges or visible water can differ, and valley length must use matching endpoints.

knowledge.text: 誤解：蜿蜒度較大必然代表所有生態功能與防洪能力較好 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

options: 蜿蜒度較大必然代表所有生態功能與防洪能力較好

quiz.explanationEn: Sinuosity compares channel-centreline length with a valley reference route, describing plan geometry rather than habitat quality or flood safety. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 蜿蜒度與量測尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sinuosity and measurement scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sinuosity and measurement scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless。適用邊界：相同起訖點與固定中心線定義，只描述平面長度比。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: Matching endpoints and a fixed centreline definition; describes plan-length ratio only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用同一底圖投影及解析度數化工程前後中心線，保留起訖點和谷地基準路徑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Digitize both centrelines using the same projection and resolution, preserving endpoints and valley reference.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless。適用邊界：相同起訖點與固定中心線定義，只描述平面長度比。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: Matching endpoints and a fixed centreline definition; describes plan-length ratio only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sinuosity and measurement scale", which statement holds?
options: 幾何蓄水容量直接等於河川洪峰流量減少量
岸坡流失的原位體積必然在同一時刻全部通過下游斷面
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless。
optionsEn: Geometric storage volume directly equals the reduction in river peak discharge
All in-place bank erosion volume necessarily passes the downstream section at the same moment
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 蜿蜒度與量測尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sinuosity and measurement scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sinuosity and measurement scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用同一底圖投影及解析度數化工程前後中心線，保留起訖點和谷地基準路徑。以第二位判讀者重畫部分彎道估計主觀差異，再將長度改變與實際開挖或自然遷移位置核對，避免把繪圖密度當成果。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Digitize both centrelines using the same projection and resolution, preserving endpoints and valley reference. Have another interpreter redraw selected bends to estimate subjective variation, then compare length changes with actual excavation or migration rather than treating denser digitizing as improvement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在谷地長度固定下將河長增加一成重算蜿蜒度，另畫一個增加長度但缺少洪氾空間的方案。說明還需哪些水理及生態證據才能比較兩者。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase channel length by ten percent at fixed valley length and recalculate sinuosity. Sketch a longer channel without additional floodplain space, then identify hydraulic and ecological evidence needed to compare the alternatives.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同年份使用不同解析度影像可能製造虛假蜿蜒度增加，洪水影像還可能把漫流支線誤認主槽。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Different image resolutions can create false sinuosity gains, while flood imagery may confuse overbank branches with the main channel. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 使用同一底圖投影及解析度數化工程前後中心線，保留起訖點和谷地基準路徑。以第二位判讀者重畫部分彎道估計主觀差異，再將長度改變與實際開挖或自然遷移位置核對，避免把繪圖密度當成果。
knowledge.textEn: Digitize both centrelines using the same projection and resolution, preserving endpoints and valley reference. Have another interpreter redraw selected bends to estimate subjective variation, then compare length changes with actual excavation or migration rather than treating denser digitizing as improvement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在谷地長度固定下將河長增加一成重算蜿蜒度，另畫一個增加長度但缺少洪氾空間的方案。說明還需哪些水理及生態證據才能比較兩者。
knowledge.textEn: Increase channel length by ten percent at fixed valley length and recalculate sinuosity. Sketch a longer channel without additional floodplain space, then identify hydraulic and ecological evidence needed to compare the alternatives.

quiz.question: 要驗證「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sinuosity and measurement scale"?
options: 使用同一底圖投影及解析度數化工程前後中心線，保留起訖點和谷地基準路徑。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
達西通量就是孔隙中每個水粒子的實際移動速度
optionsEn: Digitize both centrelines using the same projection and resolution, preserving endpoints and valley reference.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Darcy flux is the actual speed of every water particle inside the pores
quiz.explanation: 使用同一底圖投影及解析度數化工程前後中心線，保留起訖點和谷地基準路徑。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Digitize both centrelines using the same projection and resolution, preserving endpoints and valley reference. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 蜿蜒度與量測尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sinuosity and measurement scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sinuosity and measurement scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不同年份使用不同解析度影像可能製造虛假蜿蜒度增加，洪水影像還可能把漫流支線誤認主槽。診斷應先檢查中心線定義及流量條件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different image resolutions can create false sinuosity gains, while flood imagery may confuse overbank branches with the main channel. Check centreline definitions and flow conditions before interpreting apparent geometric improvement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此工程前後比較應維持相同定義與解析度，先確認幾何變化是真實河道重組而非測圖方式改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Keep definitions and resolution consistent before and after works so an apparent change represents channel reorganization rather than a different surveying method or mapping scale.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「蜿蜒度較大必然代表所有生態功能與防洪能力較好」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Greater sinuosity necessarily means better ecological function and flood protection in every respect" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 不同年份使用不同解析度影像可能製造虛假蜿蜒度增加，洪水影像還可能把漫流支線誤認主槽。診斷應先檢查中心線定義及流量條件。
knowledge.textEn: Different image resolutions can create false sinuosity gains, while flood imagery may confuse overbank branches with the main channel. Check centreline definitions and flow conditions before interpreting apparent geometric improvement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 展長後的平均坡度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mean slope after lengthening: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「展長後的平均坡度」如何影響河川再蜿蜒工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mean slope after lengthening” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River remeandering works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在上游與下游控制高程不變時，河道展長會降低沿程平均坡度，但各彎段的床坡不必均勻。局部深潭、淺瀨與回水可能分配大部分水頭損失，因此不能把平均坡度直接視為每一點能坡。坡度降低也會改變輸砂能力，若上游供砂維持不變，河床可能淤積再調整。設計應把高程控制、幾何長度與預期泥砂交換連在一起，而非只透過平面曲線追求更大的蜿蜒度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「展長後的平均坡度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: With fixed upstream and downstream control elevations, channel lengthening reduces mean longitudinal slope, but individual bends need not share that slope. Pools, riffles and backwater distribute losses unevenly, so mean bed slope is not the energy slope everywhere. Lower slope can alter transport capacity and trigger deposition when upstream sediment supply persists. Connect elevation controls, channel geometry and sediment exchange rather than pursuing a larger sinuosity value through planform geometry alone without checking adjustment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mean slope after lengthening” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: dz=3 m; L=1800 m; S=dz/L=0.001666667 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「河道平均床坡就是所有流量下每一斷面的能量坡度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mean bed slope equals the energy slope at every section and discharge" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「展長後的平均坡度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 展長後的平均坡度：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「展長後的平均坡度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mean slope after lengthening” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：dz=3 m; L=1800 m; S=dz/L=0.001666667 dimensionless。適用邊界：固定兩端床高的平均幾何坡度，不代替局部能坡或輸砂平衡。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: dz=3 m; L=1800 m; S=dz/L=0.001666667 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: Mean geometric slope at fixed endpoint bed levels, not local energy slope or sediment equilibrium. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：重測兩端控制高程與沿程縱斷面，將深潭、淺瀨及構造物逐一標示。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey endpoint controls and the full profile, identifying pools, riffles and structures.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 展長後的平均坡度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mean slope after lengthening: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「展長後的平均坡度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mean slope after lengthening” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 重測兩端控制高程與沿程縱斷面，將深潭、淺瀨及構造物逐一標示。另量代表流量下水面坡度，對照床坡差異；若出現大範圍回水，應調查下游控制而非把所有差異歸因於新彎道。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey endpoint controls and the full profile, identifying pools, riffles and structures. Measure water-surface slope at representative discharge and compare with bed slope. Extensive backwater requires investigating downstream control instead of attributing every difference to the new bends. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將河長縮短三百公尺重算平均坡度，保持兩端高程不變。畫出兩個具有相同平均坡但局部深潭配置不同的縱斷面，說明其水理仍可能不同。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Shorten the channel by three hundred metres with endpoint levels fixed and recalculate slope. Draw two profiles with identical mean slope but different pool distributions, explaining why their hydraulic behaviour may still differ.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只增加河長卻忽略下游固定水位，上游可能產生預期外壅水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Lengthening while ignoring a fixed downstream level can create unexpected upstream backwater. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「展長後的平均坡度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mean slope after lengthening"?

steps.title: 展長後的平均坡度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mean slope after lengthening: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「展長後的平均坡度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 若只增加河長卻忽略下游固定水位，上游可能產生預期外壅水。床面局部淤積也可能重新縮短有效流路，需追蹤水面與地形的共同演變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Lengthening while ignoring a fixed downstream level can create unexpected upstream backwater. Local deposition may also shorten the effective flow path, requiring joint monitoring of water levels and evolving channel geometry. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計應把高程控制、幾何長度與預期泥砂交換連在一起，而非只透過平面曲線追求更大的蜿蜒度。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 粗糙度與通水尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Roughness and conveyance scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「粗糙度與通水尺度」如何影響河川再蜿蜒工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Roughness and conveyance scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River remeandering works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 復育後植生、木構與河床形態會改變阻力，用曼寧式可初步比較斷面通水尺度，但必須確認近似均勻流及適用的單位系統。粗糙係數不是純粹材料常數，會隨淹水深度、植生彎伏和季節改變。複式斷面中主槽與洪氾地的交換也難由單一係數描述。計算應保留面積、水力半徑與能坡各自來源，不可用調整係數掩蓋幾何或邊界條件的錯誤。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「粗糙度與通水尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Restored vegetation, wood and bed forms change resistance. Manning's relation offers a preliminary conveyance comparison under approximately uniform flow and a stated unit system. Roughness is not merely a material constant; depth, plant reconfiguration and season affect it. Exchange between the main channel and floodplain also exceeds a single-coefficient description. Keep the origins of area, hydraulic radius and energy slope explicit instead of tuning roughness to conceal errors in geometry or boundary conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Roughness and conveyance scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：n=0.04 s/m^(1/3); A=24 m2; R=1.2 m; S=0.0015 dimensionless; Q=A*R^(2/3)*sqrt(S)/n=26.241241 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: n=0.04 s/m^(1/3); A=24 m2; R=1.2 m; S=0.0015 dimensionless; Q=A*R^(2/3)*sqrt(S)/n=26.241241 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「曼寧粗糙係數只由材料決定且永遠不隨水深改變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A blocked entrance can make mapped storage inaccessible, while rapid drainage can return water during the peak. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 洪氾入口堵塞可能使圖上容量無法使用，出口過快又可能把水送回洪峰。應檢查連通與時間，而非只增加名義土地面積。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transverse water level in bends” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River remeandering works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水流轉彎需要向心加速度，橫向水面坡度可提供相應壓力差，因此外彎水面可能較高。簡化關係以平均速度、河寬和曲率半徑建立尺度，但真實彎道還有二次流、深槽及垂直速度分布。外彎侵蝕並不只由水面高差決定，近床流向與土體條件同樣重要。再蜿蜒設計應把曲率、岸趾及洪氾邊界一起檢查，避免把平面美觀的急彎當成自然穩定形狀。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「彎道橫向水面差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Turning flow requires centripetal acceleration, which a transverse water-surface gradient can help supply, producing higher levels near the outer bend. A simplified relation uses mean velocity, width and curvature radius, while real bends include secondary circulation, thalweg variation and vertical velocity structure. Outer-bank erosion is not determined by surface difference alone; near-bed currents and soil matter. Examine curvature, toe conditions and floodplain boundaries together rather than assuming an attractive planform is naturally stable. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Transverse water level in bends” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 在同一斷面同步量內外彎水位，並取得垂向與橫向流速資料。量測曲率時保持中心線定義一致，若水面差與簡式偏離，先查回水、非均勻速度及幾何急變，不把偏差全歸為測量誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.instruction: 允許河道在限定走廊內遷移，可以提供沉積物和新生棲地，但也需要清楚界定土地、設施與管理邊界。岸線後退距離乘長度與平均高度，可初估流失土體的原位體積，並非全部會立即成為下游懸浮泥砂。崩落土塊可能暫存岸趾、再被洪水分次帶走，細粗料行為也不同。監測應區分平面遷移、體積侵蝕與輸出通量，避免把三個量互相代替。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岸線遷移與土方體積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Monitor planform movement, volumetric erosion and exported flux separately rather than substituting one quantity for another. steps.title: 側汊連通的交換水量：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Exchange volume through a side channel” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River remeandering works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 再連接側汊可改變主槽與洪氾地的水量、泥砂和生物交換，但流向可能隨主河水位升降而反轉。流量乘時間只適用於已知定常流段，變動事件需要逐時積分並保留正負號。流入量不等同淨蓄水，若另一出口同時排出，水體只是通過。設計應把入口、出口與內部水位畫成控制體，並關注過低水位時是否形成孤立水塘或阻斷生物退路。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「側汊連通的交換水量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reconnecting a side channel changes water, sediment and biological exchange with the main river, but direction can reverse as river stage rises and falls. Discharge times duration applies to a known steady interval; variable events require signed integration. Inflow is not net storage when another outlet simultaneously drains the area. Draw inlet, outlet and internal water levels as a control volume and examine whether low stages isolate pools or interrupt return routes for organisms. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Exchange volume through a side channel” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「側汊連通的交換水量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Exchange volume through a side channel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Q=0.8 m3/s into-side-channel; dt=7200 s; Vin=Q*dt=5760 m3。適用邊界：定常向內流量之總流入體積，不等於淨蓄水或削峰量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Q=0.8 m3/s into-side-channel; dt=7200 s; Vin=Q*dt=5760 m3. Applicable boundary: Gross inflow volume during steady inward flow, not net storage or peak attenuation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water advection and flood-wave travel” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River remeandering works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 河道延長可能增加水體沿流路的平移時間，但洪波傳播速度並不等於水粒子平均流速。以長度除速度得到的是固定速度的平流尺度，未計彌散、死水交換或水位波形變化。示蹤物可能早到也可能留下長尾，洪峰則受蓄水及邊界影響。評估復育的時間效益時，應分別量測示蹤突破、洪水歷線與局部流速，避免用水的旅行時間直接宣稱下游洪峰必然延後同樣秒數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水體平移與洪波傳播」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lengthening can increase water-parcel advection time, but flood-wave celerity differs from mean parcel velocity. Length divided by velocity gives a constant-speed advection scale without dispersion, inactive-zone exchange or changing wave shape. Tracers can arrive early and leave long tails, while flood peaks depend on storage and boundaries. Evaluate tracer breakthrough, hydrographs and local velocity separately rather than claiming downstream peak delay directly from the calculated travel time of water parcels through the restored reach. steps.title: 水體平移與洪波傳播：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水體平移與洪波傳播」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water advection and flood-wave travel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：L=1800 m; u=0.6 m/s; ta=L/u=3000 s。適用邊界：定常均速平流時間尺度，不是洪峰傳播或完整示蹤停留分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: L=1800 m; u=0.6 m/s; ta=L/u=3000 s. Applicable boundary: Steady uniform advection scale, not flood-peak travel or a full tracer residence distribution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在合法且適合的示蹤試驗中量測上下游濃度曲線，另用同步水位流量觀測洪波。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 水體平移與洪波傳播：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water advection and flood-wave travel” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在合法且適合的示蹤試驗中量測上下游濃度曲線，另用同步水位流量觀測洪波。比較首達、質心與峰值時間，並說明各自物理意義；若差異大，檢查死水交換及沿程支流，不能任選最有利數字。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use an appropriate authorized tracer test for concentration histories and synchronized level-discharge observations for flood waves. Compare first arrival, centroid and peak times with their distinct meanings. Large differences warrant checking inactive-zone exchange and tributaries rather than selecting a favourable statistic. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將平均流速降低兩成重算平流時間，再畫一條有長尾的示蹤曲線及一條洪水歷線。標出不能直接互換的時間，列出檢驗削峰所需額外資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce mean velocity by twenty percent and recalculate advection time. Draw a long-tailed tracer curve and a flood hydrograph, label noninterchangeable times, and identify additional evidence needed to evaluate peak attenuation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把示蹤質心時間當洪峰延遲，可能誇大防洪效果；相反地，忽略長尾也會低估污染物停留。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using tracer-centroid travel as flood-peak delay can exaggerate protection, while ignoring long tails understates contaminant persistence. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Uncertainty in terrain differences” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River remeandering works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 工程前後地形差分可找出沖淤，但小變化可能只是測量誤差。兩期獨立隨機高程誤差的標準差可用平方和開根號合成，若兩期共享基準偏差或植生遮蔽，獨立假設便不成立。單點標準差也不等於整個土方體積的誤差，空間相關會改變總量不確定性。分析應先分離系統偏差與隨機分散，再清楚報告檢出尺度，而不把所有不同顏色像元當成真實侵蝕或沉積。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地形差分的量測不確定性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Terrain differencing reveals erosion and deposition, but small changes may be survey noise. Independent random elevation standard deviations combine by root sum of squares; shared datum errors or vegetation bias violate independence. Point uncertainty also differs from volume uncertainty because spatial correlation affects aggregation. Separate systematic bias from random scatter and state the detection scale clearly, rather than interpreting every coloured difference pixel as real morphological change or assigning confidence without an explicit error model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Uncertainty in terrain differences” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：s1=0.03 m; s2=0.04 m; sd=sqrt(s1^2+s2^2)=0.05 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: s1=0.03 m; s2=0.04 m; sd=sqrt(s1^2+s2^2)=0.05 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩期地形圖任何非零差值都代表真實河床變化」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.title: 地形差分的量測不確定性

knowledge.textEn: Terrain differencing reveals erosion and deposition, but small changes may be survey noise. Independent random elevation standard deviations combine by root sum of squares; shared datum errors or vegetation bias violate independence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩期地形圖任何非零差值都代表真實河床變化 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every nonzero difference between two terrain surveys represents real bed change Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地形差分的量測不確定性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Uncertainty in terrain differences" is correct?
options: 兩期地形圖任何非零差值都代表真實河床變化
工程前後地形差分可找出沖淤，但小變化可能只是測量誤差。
蜿蜒度較大必然代表所有生態功能與防洪能力較好
optionsEn: Every nonzero difference between two terrain surveys represents real bed change
Terrain differencing reveals erosion and deposition, but small changes may be survey noise.
Greater sinuosity necessarily means better ecological function and flood protection in every respect
quiz.explanation: 工程前後地形差分可找出沖淤，但小變化可能只是測量誤差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Terrain differencing reveals erosion and deposition, but small changes may be survey noise. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地形差分的量測不確定性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Uncertainty in terrain differences: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地形差分的量測不確定性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Uncertainty in terrain differences” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：s1=0.03 m; s2=0.04 m; sd=sqrt(s1^2+s2^2)=0.05 m。適用邊界：兩期獨立零均值隨機誤差的差分標準差，非自動的可信界限。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: s1=0.03 m; s2=0.04 m; sd=sqrt(s1^2+s2^2)=0.05 m. Applicable boundary: Difference standard deviation for independent zero-mean random errors, not an automatic confidence bound. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在穩定未變區檢查兩期高程偏差，先校正可識別系統差，再分析殘差分布與空間相關。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check differences on stable ground, correct identifiable systematic shifts, and examine residual distributions and spatial correlation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

A small transverse water-level difference proves that the outer bank will not erode

steps.title: 地形差分的量測不確定性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Uncertainty in terrain differences: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地形差分的量測不確定性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Uncertainty in terrain differences” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在穩定未變區檢查兩期高程偏差，先校正可識別系統差，再分析殘差分布與空間相關。用獨立控制點驗證，並分別報裸地與植生區精度；設定檢出門檻時需交代誤差分布及採用的信心水準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check differences on stable ground, correct identifiable systematic shifts, and examine residual distributions and spatial correlation. Validate with independent control points and separate bare-ground from vegetated accuracy. Any detection threshold needs a stated error distribution and confidence level. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：假設第二期標準差降到兩公分，重算差分精度並比較改善幅度。再提出兩期誤差相關的情況，說明為何不能繼續使用獨立平方和公式宣稱同樣精度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce the second survey standard deviation to two centimetres and recompute difference uncertainty. Describe a source of correlated errors and explain why the independent root-sum-square formula would then require modification before claiming equivalent accuracy.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未校正的共同高程偏移會讓整段河道看似淤積或侵蝕，植生高度也可能被當成地面。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An uncorrected datum shift can make the whole reach appear to deposit or erode, and vegetation may be mistaken for ground. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Check differences on stable ground, correct identifiable systematic shifts, and examine residual distributions and spatial correlation. Validate with independent control points and separate bare-ground from vegetated accuracy. Any detection threshold needs a stated error distribution and confidence level.

knowledge.textEn: Reduce the second survey standard deviation to two centimetres and recompute difference uncertainty. Describe a source of correlated errors and explain why the independent root-sum-square formula would then require modification before claiming equivalent accuracy.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地形差分的量測不確定性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Uncertainty in terrain differences"?
options: 在穩定未變區檢查兩期高程偏差，先校正可識別系統差，再分析殘差分布與空間相關。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

quiz.explanationEn: Check differences on stable ground, correct identifiable systematic shifts, and examine residual distributions and spatial correlation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地形差分的量測不確定性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Uncertainty in terrain differences: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地形差分的量測不確定性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Uncertainty in terrain differences” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未校正的共同高程偏移會讓整段河道看似淤積或侵蝕，植生高度也可能被當成地面。若差分呈現整區同號，應先查基準及分類再解釋地形過程。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An uncorrected datum shift can make the whole reach appear to deposit or erode, and vegetation may be mistaken for ground. Region-wide differences of one sign call for checking datum and classification before interpreting geomorphic processes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：分析應先分離系統偏差與隨機分散，再清楚報告檢出尺度，而不把所有不同顏色像元當成真實侵蝕或沉積。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separate systematic bias from random scatter and state the detection scale clearly, rather than interpreting every coloured difference pixel as real morphological change or assigning confidence without an explicit error model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩期地形圖任何非零差值都代表真實河床變化」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every nonzero difference between two terrain surveys represents real bed change" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未校正的共同高程偏移會讓整段河道看似淤積或侵蝕，植生高度也可能被當成地面。若差分呈現整區同號，應先查基準及分類再解釋地形過程。
knowledge.textEn: An uncorrected datum shift can make the whole reach appear to deposit or erode, and vegetation may be mistaken for ground. Region-wide differences of one sign call for checking datum and classification before interpreting geomorphic processes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地形差分的量測不確定性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Uncertainty in terrain differences" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。

蜿蜒度較大必然代表所有生態功能與防洪能力較好
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An uncorrected datum shift can make the whole reach appear to deposit or erode, and vegetation may be mistaken for ground.
Greater sinuosity necessarily means better ecological function and flood protection in every respect
